related.title: OAuth PKCE：公開客戶端的挑戰/驗證配對
related.titleEn: OAuth PKCE: challenge/verifier binding for public clients
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 validation-errors.csv與strict/permissive對照。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver validation-errors.csv and strict/permissive comparisons.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 用hashlib SHA-256與urlsafe_b64encode計算固定向量，必須與RFC附錄預期相同；固定向量只能測試，不得用於真實登入。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Compute the fixed vector with hashlib SHA-256 and URL-safe base64,matching the RFC result;the fixed vector is test-only. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 2/6*100 = 33.33333333333333 percent；對照 4/6*100 = 66.66666666666666 percent。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐筆輸出失敗關鍵字與JSON pointer；不能只回false而無位置，Python bool不可誤當本模型integer。

基準 32*8 = 256 bits；對照 ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
用hashlib SHA-256與urlsafe_b64encode計算固定向量，必須與RFC附錄預期相同；固定向量只能測試，不得用於真實登入。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 2/6*100 = 33.33333333333333 percent; comparison 4/6*100 = 66.66666666666666 percent. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Emit failing keyword and JSON pointer per fixture;avoid locationless false results,and do not treat Python bool as an integer in this model.

Baseline 32*8 = 256 bits; comparison ceil(32*8/6) = 43 characters. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Compute the fixed vector with hashlib SHA-256 and URL-safe base64,matching the RFC result;the fixed vector is test-only.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: POSIX pthread：條件變數與遺失喚醒
related.titleEn: POSIX pthreads: condition predicates and lost wakeups
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 validation-errors.csv與strict/permissive對照。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver validation-errors.csv and strict/permissive comparisons.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 列鎖、predicate、wait原子解鎖、signal、重新取鎖的事件；將if版本與while版本放入同一排程。
related.differenceEn: Trace lock, predicate, wait’s atomic unlock, signal and reacquisition, placing if and while variants in one schedule.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 2/6*100 = 33.33333333333333 percent；對照 4/6*100 = 66.66666666666666 percent。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐筆輸出失敗關鍵字與JSON pointer；不能只回false而無位置，Python bool不可誤當本模型integer。

條件變數等待必須在互斥鎖保護下反覆檢查predicate；喚醒是重新檢查的機會，不是資源保證。
本課數值核對：6-2 = 4 items；另一項核對：1-1 = 0 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 2/6*100 = 33.33333333333333 percent; comparison 4/6*100 = 66.66666666666666 percent. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Emit failing keyword and JSON pointer per fixture;avoid locationless false results,and do not treat Python bool as an integer in this model.

Condition waits recheck a predicate in a loop under its mutex; waking is an opportunity to recheck, not a resource grant.
Numeric audit: 6-2 = 4 items; second audit: 1-1 = 0 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
